TITLE:
SC Flags Missing Pages, Fee Shortfalls in INDIA Bloc and Rahul Gandhi Pleas

DESCRIPTION:
Supreme Court finds over ten defects in INDIA bloc's plea against CEC, noting missing pages and Rs 200 fee shortfall. It also flags similar issues in Rahul Gandhi's petition against SIR, citing missing pages and Rs 220 shortfall. #SupremeCourt #IndiaPolitics #LegalNews #CourtFees
